heading: Commercial electrical services
intro:
Everything a commercial tenancy needs, delivered by one team that understands how fitouts run.
We work for builders, project managers, landlords and tenants across Brisbane.

services.title: Commercial fitouts
services.summary: Turnkey electrical for multi-floor, full-floor and part-floor tenancies, plus lobbies, common areas and end-of-trip facilities.

services.title: Power and switchboards
services.summary: Switchboards, mains and submains, metering and UPS systems sized and installed to suit the building and the tenancy.

services.title: Data and communications
services.summary: Structured cabling and fibre installed neatly and certified, with comms rooms planned around the equipment going in.

services.title: Lighting and controls
services.summary: Lighting that shapes how people use a workplace, with energy efficient fittings and smart controls that reduce running costs.

services.title: Asset maintenance
services.summary: Ongoing electrical maintenance for landlords, asset managers and facilities teams who need a reliable contractor on call.
